item.title: Raised ironworks and bad repair, 18th November
item.description:
The ironworks are raised and its causing people to trip over it or lose footing. My office faces this path and I regularly see children struggle with it on pushbikes etc. This morning a girl around 9 was walking to school and took quite a bad fall over it, she was shaken up and hobbled away slowly. The issues along this pathway have been present for a while but much more severe this summer time due to the dry weather causing breaks in the tarmac. The whole pathway is very poor now and eroding away.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 96, Broad Oak Way, Hatherley, Cheltenham
